INNER HEAD. [3] [Cod.]
Dull headache in morning, which gradually diminishes until noon, when it disappears.
Dull headache soon after getting up in morning, < on l. side, and lasting about two hours.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Cod.]
Involuntary twitching of left eyelid, sometimes > by rubbing.
Involuntary twitching of both eyelids, whenever he attempted to read or write.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Cod.]
Painful soreness of skin of face and scalp, which remained after a severe attack of neuralgia.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Cod.]
Empty eructations, with acute pains in stomach.
Nausea and vomiting.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Cod.]
Violent spasmodic pain at pit of stomach.
Gastralgia.
Affections of stomach or abdomen, dependent on disorder of solar plexus of great sympathetic.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Cod.]
She passed five pints of urine daily, specific gravity 10.40 and sugar to the extent of 32.72 grains ; < from anxiety and overwork.
The urine previously saccharine contained no trace of sugar.
   

COUGH. [27] [Cod.]
Short, irritating cough < during night.
Troublesome cough, with copious mucous and sometimes purulent expectoration.
Obstinate cough with expectoration and nervous excitability.
Night cough of phthisical patients.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Cod.]
Spasmodic twitches in arms.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Cod.]
Involuntary twitchings of lower limbs.
Painful, spasmodic jerking of legs.
Neuralgic pains in thighs and legs, and subacute rheumatic pains in knee and ankle joints.
   

NERVES. [36] [Cod.]
Trembling of whole body.
Morbid sensitiveness of surface in nervous and hysterical females.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Cod.]
Sudden twitchings during sleep, so violent as to wake up the sleeper in affright. θ Chorea.
Disturbed sleep from frightful dreams, causing patients to wake in morning exhausted and unrefreshed.
Sleep constantly disturbed by severe night cough. θ Phthisis.
   

SKIN. [46] [Cod.]
Troublesome itching of eczema and porrigo.
